comments:
According to the colophon, gZhon nu rin chen relies on the explanations of "Chos kyi ye shes," i.e. Nyang bran Chos kyi ye shes (ID:3876) in view of the reference to "Nyang gi bran" in the conclusive verses, and of "brTson 'grus seng ge," likely gTsang nag pa (ID:3839), as the latter was a student of Nyang bran.
The work could correspond to the "bslab btus Tik+ka" listed by A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 514, No. 11073: gzhon nu rin chen gyi bslab btus Tik+ka).
